report: Some users are randomly logged out after refreshing the page. It happens mostly when they come back to the app after a while (access token expired). No error is shown, they just land on the login page.
trigger: User returns to app after absence (access token has expired). Browser/frontend calls POST /auth/refresh to get a new access token. Instead of succeeding, the user is silently redirected to login.

repro_test.command: cd demo-app/api && npx vitest run tests/repro/random-logout.test.ts
key_output: FAIL  tests/repro/random-logout.test.ts > repro: silent logout on concurrent /auth/refresh with same cookie > when two refresh requests race with the same rt cookie, the session survives — new token must still work
AssertionError: expected 401 to be 200 // Object.is equality
